services.name: Party Boat Rental
services.desc: Looking for an unforgettable experience on Douglas Lake? Our luxury tritoon rentals, driven by a licensed captain, can accommodate up to 12 passengers, with the option to add more friends for an even bigger celebration. Perfect for birthday parties, bachelor and bachelorette parties, or family outings, we have everything you need for an incredible time on the water. To make your outing even more seamless, we also offer professional transportation options upon request-including party buses and limousine services-so your group can arrive in style and safety without the hassle of coordinating rides. State-of-the-art sound system, water slide, lily pad, lounge inflatable platform, clean onboard restroom on party boats

blurb: Guests can rent luxury party boats with licensed captains for celebrations on Douglas Lake, or rent jet skis and kayaks with overnight delivery to various Tennessee lakes. Party boats include amenities like a water slide, sound system, and restroom. Kayak and jet ski rentals offer flexible durations and delivery options to lakeside properties or launch points.
